source.text: Nordheim-Fuchs: E(t) = (rho0 / gamma)(1 + tanh(rho0 (t - tp) / (2 Lambda))) at the end of the window (2376454.2 J of reactor energy, peak power 222792915 W at 24.253 ms), times peaking / (pins x length) for the slice. The tolerance covers the thinning of the generated history (energy within 1e-3) and its integration.
